en: A Romanian holiday postcard. Front shows an illustration of a deer resting in a snowy winter scene with the greeting 'La multi ani'. Back has pre-printed Romanian address fields, a blue imprinted stamp reading '40 BANI POSTA ROMANA' with a snowflake, the price line, and a purple round sender stamp from the Ion Creanga Theatre union in Bucharest; the addressee name is handwritten.
